metric: AN-05: strong = share of pixels whose largest RGB channel differs by more than 64 after a 3x3 box blur; mean = mean largest RGB channel difference (0-255); heightDifference = |native - Cordova| px at scale 3. Each case passes within its value plus `margin`.

reasons.settings pages (units*, radio-*): Glyph rasterization of the row and title texts only (WebKit places glyphs on its own subpixel grid; Korean falls back to Apple SD Gothic Neo in both): rows, borders, the check mark and the back arrow are at the captured positions within 1 px after the measured offsets (radio labels 2/3 pt above S07's, the check mark 14 pt inside the edge and 2 pt below the label's center). Compared from the top to 40 pt under the list; the rest is checked as the list's background.
reasons.hourly-* (-0 header block, -1 chart): IN-08's header block and IN-05's chart in the theme of the state: glyph rasterization of the temperature, the summary and the chart labels, the photo theme's outline, image filtering (the forecast-tolerances reasons).
reasons.about: IN-07's popup over the menu and Ionic's backdrop: glyph rasterization of the menu rows, the title, the three lines and the button. The lines are 18 pt apart as WebKit lays them out (IonicPopupView's line spacing, IN-12); before that change the Korean popup measured strong 0.0175 and mean 3.38.
reasons.headroom: Each case is its local measurement (`measured`, Xcode 27.2, iOS 26.5 simulator) times 1.5 plus 0.0005 for strong and times 1.2 plus 0.2 for mean, rounded up, plus `margin`: CI renders with Xcode 26.6, whose text rasterization IN-08 measured up to about twice as far from WebKit on text-heavy blocks. The height must match.
reasons.sensitivity: plans/ios-native.md, IN-12 checks: the mutations these values detect.
